content.title: THE {{MINERAL}} MOST PEOPLE ARE QUIETLY RUNNING LOW ON
facts: **Copper** (Collagen Builder) — Cashews | Dark Chocolate | Lentils | Shiitake Mushrooms
**Manganese** (Bone Architect) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Chickpeas | Pecans
**Selenium** (Thyroid Guardian) — Brazil Nuts | Sardines | Sunflower Seeds | Brown Rice
**Magnesium** (Nerve Calmer) — Pumpkin Seeds | Swiss Chard | Black Beans | Almonds
**Iron** (Oxygen Carrier) — Lentils | Spinach | Pumpkin Seeds | Dark Turkey Meat
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Hemp Seeds | Chickpeas | Cashews | Pumpkin Seeds
**Iodine** (Metabolism Switch) — Seaweed | Cod | Shrimp | Iodized Salt
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these minerals do more than most people realize. Copper might sound random, but it works quietly alongside iron to help your body actually form red blood cells — without enough of it, iron supplements alone won't fix low energy. Manganese plays a direct role in activating the enzymes that build and maintain bone density, something that usually only gets credit to calcium. And selenium is one of the few minerals your thyroid literally cannot function properly without, since it helps convert thyroid hormone into its active form. That said, everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how yours responds rather than chasing numbers.

This is what @smarthealthfix is all about: breaking down nutrition, common health issues, the way your organs actually function, and the small daily habits that tie it all together. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
